note: The fleet's one-way door registry — the single enumerated list that gate-classification.md's classification table and sandbox-policy.md's Ask-First bucket point at (#366: freeze entered through gate-classification's freeze-gate prose and mission-scheduling, not the old MD list, so the registry now OWNS the enumeration). A door is hard or impossible to reverse, or out of the fleet's authority: HUMAN ONLY, never auto-resolved, never defaulted on timeout. Each door carries a keyword net of destructive PHRASINGS. The net exists so an unregistered wording can never be auto-decided: runtime/scripts/decisions.py refuses a DECISIONS line whose text matches a net but whose class is not one-way, and refuses a one-way line that carries no human source. Keywords are matched as substrings against the whole line after decisions.py fold() canonicalisation (case, hyphens and punctuation flatten; filler words drop; common verb forms and a small destructive-verb synonym set fold to one token), so each is a multi-word phrase — a single common word would fire on ordinary prose and train people to ignore the refusal.

doors.title: Merge to the default branch (or promote BASE to it)
doors.why: Other people's work is rebuilt on top of it; a bad merge is reverted in public, not undone.

doors.title: Deploy to a shared or production environment
doors.why: Deployment changes what real users are running; the blast radius is outside the repo.
keywords: push the image to the registry

doors.title: Roll back a deployed release
doors.why: A rollback is itself a deploy, and it strands whatever shipped after the target.
keywords: restore the previous version in prod

doors.title: Delete data, an unmerged or default branch, a dirty worktree, or infrastructure
doors.why: Deletion has no undo once the tree is gone; a shape check is not authorization. Routine teardown is NOT this door: deleting a unit branch whose PR merged (gh pr merge --merge --delete-branch) and retiring that unit's clean worktree are ungated conductor steps (merge-serialization.md, dispatch-lifecycle.md), so the net names the deletions that lose work or a shared ref (2026-10-23 review, P2-36).
keywords: get rid of the unmerged branch

doors.title: Commit money the fleet does not hold
doors.why: Spend leaves the machine and the fleet holds no budget authority.

doors.title: Change the frozen scope of a run
doors.why: The denominator is the whole proof; moving it retroactively makes every completion claim unfalsifiable.

doors.title: Rotate or revoke a secret
doors.why: Rotation invalidates every holder of the old value, including systems nobody enumerated.

doors.title: Use, provision, or move live credentials
doors.why: A real credential in a worker's context is an incident whether or not it is used.
keywords: add the secret to the repo

doors.title: Freeze or unfreeze the run's contract
doors.why: The freeze gate is where a human takes ownership of the target; the fleet cannot open or close it for them.
